# ffxf_roles (Data Source)

Lists the roles of the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ffxf_roles" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `roles` (Attributes List) Roles of the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) Role description.
- `id` (Number) Role identifier.
- `name` (String) Role name.
- `policy_ids` (List of Number) Identifiers of the policies the role carries.
